title: BBC Presents Alfred Hitchcock
paragraphs: A library collection of BBC radio adaptations of suspense stories associated with Alfred Hitchcock. It is treated here as a collection label rather than a single continuous historical radio series.
Curated BBC collection spanning 1983-2022. It combines radio adaptations of novels/plays/stories associated with Hitchcock films with documentary/original dramas about Hitchcock.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Classic adaptation period (December 3, 1983 to October 25, 2003) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]], Retrospectives and later adaptations (April 28, 2005 to September 29, 2011) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]], and Late Hitchcock project/original drama period (November 6, 2015 to December 25, 2022) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Alan Rickman (performer), Benedict Cumberbatch (performer), Bill Nighy (performer), Clive Swift (performer), Hugh Laurie (performer), Michael Sheen (performer), and Neil Varley (producer).

The stories often return to Alfred Hitchcock-associated radio material, BBC radio drama preservation, literary adaptation for radio, suspense and psychological thriller, Hitchcock biography and retrospective, and unmade Hitchcock project reconstruction.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes BBC Hitchcock collection broadcast span, Alan Parker Hitchcock retrospective, The Blind Man unmade Hitchcock project dramatization, and Benny & Hitch BBC drama.
